adjudications.finding_contains: can truncate `amount_cents` in cast to `u64` without a range contract
adjudications.reason: The cast in request_transfer only runs under `amount_cents > 0`; the warning does not identify the missing non-negative check at the balance comparison.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `setWithdrawFeeBps` is an externally callable state-mutating function with no access-control guard
finding_reviews.reason: The setter does have a guard, but it authorizes on tx.origin (planted SOL01-D06). The wording is wrong, yet the finding points a reviewer at the real authorization flaw.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `bid` may be vulnerable to reentrancy
finding_reviews.reason: The refund call to the previous highestBidder runs before highestBidder/highestBid are updated. That bidder can re-enter bid() and be refunded the same highestBid twice. The planted SOL02-D01 is the related refund DoS on the same call.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `drawEarlyBirdBonus` may be vulnerable to reentrancy
finding_reviews.reason: bonusPaid is set before the external call, and re-entering drawEarlyBirdBonus reverts on it. The later bonusPool write cannot be exploited.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `earned` is an externally callable state-mutating function with no access-control guard
finding_reviews.reason: earned is a `view` function, so it is not state-mutating and needs no access control.
